## About
Old West Animal Hospital is a small practice in Mansfield where you and your pet are treated like neighbors. We want both of you to feel comfortable and supported, and we like getting to know our clients and their animals over the years.
Dr. Kevin Mondon is a graduate of Texas A&M University and is active in the Mansfield community. At home he has dogs named Bella and Birdie and a cat named Mikey. He works alongside assistants Haley and Kelli, who share their own homes with dogs and cats.
Pet owners have given us a 4.7 rating from 87 Google reviews. If you have questions about a visit, a pick-up or a price, just call and our staff will help.

## Services
- Wellness care: A thorough physical exam focused on prevention and early detection, whether your pet needs an annual checkup and vaccines or has a health concern from an illness or injury.
- Bloodwork: Bloodwork sent through IDEXX Reference Laboratories.
- Digital X-rays: Digital X-rays, with external radiologist review available depending on the exam.
- Ultrasound: Ultrasounds can be arranged at the office or referred to a specialty facility, depending on the exam.
- General surgery: Spay and neuter, soft tissue surgery, mass removals, pyometra and aural hematoma repair.
- Dental care: Dental cleanings and extractions.
- Euthanasia services: A gentle, dignified process with privacy and support for your family during a hard time.
- Cremation services: Each pet is handled with sensitivity and dignity, with private or communal cremation available.
- Heartworm and flea prevention: Products including Barrier, Heartgard Plus, Interceptor Plus, Milbeguard, Bravecto and Bravecto Plus, available at the office.
- Prescription diets: Royal Canin prescription diets kept in the office.
- Medications: Short and long term medications for pets being treated for illness or injury.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Wednesday?
A: Yes, but only in the morning, from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're closed Saturday and Sunday and see pets Monday through Friday.

Q: What forms of payment do you take?
A: We accept cash, checks, VISA, MC, AMEX, DISCOVER and CareCredit.

Q: Can I pick up prescription products without a visit?
A: Prescription products require your pet to be seen before we can dispense them.

Q: How will I know if you're closed for a holiday?
A: Our answering machine is updated for closures due to holidays, vacations or illness. Weather closures may not always make it onto the message.
